coldDefinition: page cache cleared per sample; file cache and GPU pipelines may be warm

reference.method: AB/BA alternating cold shows, same source and CVPixelBuffer, separate native devices/caches, no concurrent GPU jobs

resize.definition: same decoded page, unique target widths: base width minus 4, 8, ... 4*count (outside 3px frame tolerance); buffer allocation and initial show excluded; prefetch disabled

scope: CVPixelBuffer lock + native show + unlock; optional cachedWithClear also includes full clear; excludes buffer allocation, Swift queue, MethodChannel, Flutter texture acquisition, composition and physical display
